versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "docs-first" skill.
- Ensures all answers about specific tools are verified against the latest official documentation or repository before responding.
- Triggered for any usage, configuration, installation, or compatibility question involving a third-party library, framework, SDK, CLI, API, or program.
- Excludes purely conceptual or language syntax questions; always leans towards checking docs when in doubt.
- All answers include a compact footer with a direct link to the specific documentation page used.
